name: ux2-u4-forms
prompt:
Write public/js/forms.js (new file, about 40 lines), a classic script loaded before main.js (STU-UX2: validation messages next to the field). Top-level functions, no IIFE (main.js calls them by name). 1. `function fieldError(input, message)`: the error element's id is input.id + '-error'. If no element with that id exists, create a

with that id, class field-error and role alert, and insert it directly after the input, or after the input's following sibling when that sibling has class char-counter (input.insertAdjacentElement / after). Set its textContent to message. Set input's aria-invalid to 'true'. Add the error id to input's aria-describedby (a space-separated list; keep the ids already there, never add it twice). Focus the input. Return the error element. 2. `function clearFieldError(input)`: remove the error element (id input.id + '-error') if present, remove the aria-invalid attribute, and take the error id out of aria-describedby (remove the attribute when the list becomes empty). 3. One document listener for 'input' events: when the event target has aria-invalid="true", call clearFieldError(target). Output only the file.
